evidence.description: Before: compose_results.py has no reference to lanes anywhere; input metadata is not inspected beyond model routing, so an AEE result's lane pair is dropped on the floor.

falsification_tests: Compose a result set containing an AEE result with metadata.lanes and find no lane_states in the composed metadata, or find the lane pair altered from the input.
